tasks.title: Laravel frontend bug fix in this repo (project root), file resources/views/humanresources/hrdept/overtime/edit.blade.php: the datetimepicker input #nam (Date Overtime, name="ot_date") throws 'datetimepicker component should be placed within a non-static positioned container' when opened, because pc-bootstrap4-datetimepicker's place() walks up from the input's parent and finds no non-static (position != static) ancestor. The input sits inside <div class="col-auto"> (approximately line 28: <label for="nam" ...>Date Overtime : </label> followed by <div class="col-auto"> containing the input). Fix: add style="position: relative;" to that wrapper div — i.e. change <div class="col-auto"> to <div class="col-auto" style="position: relative;"> — matching the convention already used in resources/views/humanresources/hrdept/overtime/create.blade.php line 38 (<div class="col-md-10" style="position: relative">) and every other picker page in this app (inline style, NOT a CSS class). Do NOT touch the #mar select below it or anything else. Then run php artisan view:cache (INFO Blade templates cached successfully) and php artisan view:clear. Report the exact line changed and the view:cache result.

Laravel frontend bug fix in this repo (project root), file resources/views/humanresources/hrdept/staff/edit.blade.php: three datetimepicker inputs throw 'datetimepicker component should be placed within a non-static positioned container' when opened. (1) The Date Join input (name="join", id="jpo", around line 174) sits inside <div class="col-sm-7">; (2) the Date Confirm input (name="confirmed", id="jpo", around line 181) also sits inside <div class="col-sm-7">; (3) each children-row Date Of Birth input (id="cdo_{n}", around line 262) sits inside <div class="col-sm-7 form-group {{ $errors->has('staffchildren.*.dob') ? 'has-error' : '' }}">. All three wrappers are position:static, so the pickers cannot anchor. Fix: add style="position: relative" to EACH of these three wrapper divs (exact convention from resources/views/humanresources/hrdept/staff/create.blade.php lines 170/177: <div class="form-group row m-2 ..." style="position: relative"> — inline style, no CSS class). For the children row wrapper, change <div class="col-sm-7 form-group ..."> to <div class="col-sm-7 form-group ..." style="position: relative"> keeping the existing Blade expression inside. Do NOT touch the #dob wrapper (already has position: relative at line 31), do NOT touch any other field. Then run php artisan view:cache and php artisan view:clear; report the exact lines changed and the view:cache result.

Laravel frontend bug fix in this repo (project root), file resources/js/modules/staff/form.js: the JavaScript template that renders a NEW children row (used by both staff create and staff edit for dynamically added rows) wraps the Date Of Birth input (id="cdo_' + xc + '") in '<div class="col-sm-7 form-group ' + hasErr('staffchildren.*.dob') + '">' (around line 412-413), which is position:static — so the datetimepicker on that input throws 'datetimepicker component should be placed within a non-static positioned container' when opened (the static server-rendered rows in staff/edit.blade.php were fixed separately; this fixes the JS-added rows). Fix: add style="position: relative" to that wrapper div in the template string — change '<div class="col-sm-7 form-group ' + hasErr('staffchildren.*.dob') + '">' to '<div class="col-sm-7 form-group ' + hasErr('staffchildren.*.dob') + '" style="position: relative">'. Do NOT change any other part of the template or any other code in the file. Then run php -l resources/js/modules/staff/form.js is NOT applicable (JS) — instead verify the edit compiles by running npx mix (development build must complete: 'webpack compiled successfully') — NOTE: if Node on this machine fails npx mix for environmental reasons (Node >=23 breaks laravel-mix; the machine default is Node 22 which works), report the environment issue but confirm your edit is syntactically correct JS. Report the exact template line changed and the build result.

Verify the datetimepicker static-container sweep in this repo (project root) did not break anything: run the full PHP test suite and the route sanity check. Run `php artisan test` — the suite must stay green (expected baseline: 47 passed / 159 assertions, including the self-contained OutstationEditTest that needs NO database; note the earlier baseline note of 163 assertions — 159 is the actual current count, do NOT flag it as a regression). Also run `php artisan route:list` and confirm the routes overtime.edit, staff.edit, staff.create, staff.update, overtime.create exist and resolve. Report the exact test run result (suites, passed, failed, assertion count) with the test report contract.
